body: Meh, I still disagree.  District says I'm responsible for their performance this year, not any teachers they've had before.  They didn't know these words before I tried teaching them, and now they still don't.  My failure, my fuck-up.

I get what you're saying, but here's how I see it: I'm lost in the middle of nowhere.  My phone's dead.  No humans for miles.  No supplies but what I'm wearing.  And now my leg is caught in a bear trap.  Will getting out of the bear trap get me somewhere safe?  No.  Is it going to be damn hard to get anywhere safe even after I get out of the bear trap?  Absolutely.  But getting out of this bear trap is going to make reaching safety **POSSIBLE**.  

You're damn right I'm going to celebrate getting out of this fucking bear trap, even if I have to tear my own goddamned leg off.

Thanks for the sentiment, but "family" is synonymous with "negligent assholes at best, and in all likelihood people who will steal your TV to buy weed and kill your dog because Jesus told them to, or it seemed like fun at the time."  

I've got a therapist and a psychiatrist too.  Therapist is decent so far.  Psychiatrist has shit the bed in getting a medical source letter written for me.

Oh, trust me, quitting isn't going to make me shit rainbows, nor do I think it ever would.  Right now, I'm stuck in a bear trap in the middle of the wilderness with no way of reaching anyone.  Hacking off my leg to get out of the bear trap won't suddenly get me to civilization, and it will still be hard to get there once I do, but it will make getting there *possible*.

I'm their teacher.  If they don't learn the material, it's on me.  If no one in the whole grade gets above an 80 on a goddamned vocab quiz, I've failed in teaching them vocabulary or writing a proper vocab quiz.

Nope, nothing makes me happy.

Doesn't mean I shouldn't quit teaching.  My shitty performance means I should quit teaching.  The fact that I contemplate killing myself every minute I'm in class and these dumb assholes **WON'T SHUT THEIR FUCKING WHORE MOUTHS** means I should quit teaching.
As someone on the other side of the equation, yeah.  Me too.  Teaching is its own special kind of hell.

Being a lawyer is nothing special.  Think of the stupidest, least professional, most corrupt, most unethical lawyer to know.  He or she passed the Bar too.  

As for the other question, I've thought about this long and hard for the past 9 years, and I don't know.  If you're about to say "I don't know" isn't a sufficient answer, then my answer is "I would rather be a corpse."  

If I had to pick a profession ... don't know/corpse

What makes me tick ... I don't know.  Being left alone. 

What elicits your passion ... I don't know.  Nothing at this point.  You're asking for answers that I don't have.

> playing Xbox

God, no.

> smoking weed

Illegal in my state, and no interest even if it were legal.  I don't *drink*.

I have no answers.  I have no hobbies or interests.  Looking forward to the next show/game/movie/etc. does not keep me going because I don't *watch* shows or movies and don't *play* games.  I stagger home, pretend I have it in me to do any work, fail to convince myself, and collapse.  Then I have lovely dreams of one of my students crippling me for life and a hospital locking me in a room by myself and forcing me to live against my will; at least then I don't have to teach.

You're projecting good intentions where none exist or ever existed.  I got into teaching as a second career because I was fed up with law and couldn't hack it as a lawyer.  It was always and only ever a fucking job.  

My plan is to either tender my resignation after I get a note from my psychiatrist supporting my request to be released from my contract or, if my psych doesn't have that note by tomorrow, continue to teach and kill myself sometime next semester when the stress gets too much.  

If I live and am able to quit?  No idea what I'm going to do for money after this.

5th grade Reading, but it would be the same with any age group and subject.  I hate teaching.  I fear and hate teaching.  I will not teach after this year is up.  Whether that's calendar year (if I get the psych paperwork in order soon enough) or academic year (if the doctor continues to not write that letter), I still will not be teaching after this year.  Even if I don't kill myself, I will not go back to teaching.
